title: In-Situ Calibration of Six-Axis Force/Torque Transducers on a Six-Legged Robot
rights: Author-hosted paper available for reading. Data availability statement gives access upon reasonable request. Only four factual Table 1 model-selection statistics and new computed comparisons are recorded, no article or original samples are redistributed.
history: Existing study, newly extracted Table 1; excluded from the counts of new papers and of available datasets.
queries_and_followup: Wu Revzen in-situ calibration six-axis six-legged robot offset; followed the DOI and the authors’ PDF and checked the data availability statement.
evidence: Table 1 and Section 5.2: four models evaluated by the reported mean of mean squared errors over five folds and BIC. The full 36-parameter model has error 12; the three-parameter model has 105, or 8.75 times the rounded full-model figure. Separate residual comparisons report 63% and 90% RMSE reductions. Section 6 reports up to 10 N offset change after six months with several possible causes. These are hip-mounted transducers and a paper-level comparison.
